newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo, AEA Technology to form joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo, AEA Technology to form joint venture.

text.p: Sumitomo Corp and British science and engineering firm AEA Technology Plc will set up a joint venture to provide technology and equipment to the nuclear power industry, Sumitomo said on Wednesday.
The 50/50 venture, Summit AEA Corp, will be capitalised at 100 million yen and will start operations in Tokyo on April 1, Sumitomo said in a statement.

Business will include providing technology on ageing nuclear reactors and on the treatment of radioactive waste, as well as providing services related to dismantling old nuclear power facilities, the statement said.
